name: wall-c2: the three finalists draw the Classroom 5H window wall, alone and with their own back wall as a style reference
notes: Second scene for the shortlist (owner, 21 Oct 2026): a view through glass, weather, plants, a count the puzzle depends on (four pots at four heights), no lettering.

The reference cases prepend a line to the prompt asking for the attached picture's style; the picture is the same model's own round-three wall, so the test is whether a model can hold its own style from one wall to the next.
Benchmark in the game: next/art/classroom/landscape-c2-window.jpg (Nano Banana Pro, 28 Sept 2026).
